WITH PROV_ID AS
(SELECT
PVI_PRV_ID,
PVI_ID,
PVI_TYPE
FROM HS.PVI_PROVIDER_ID
WHERE PVI_DEL_TS IS NULL
AND PVI_TYPE IN ('XX','ST','MCD',/*'FIN','SSN',*/ 'NAV')
AND CURRENT_DATE BETWEEN PVI_EFF_DT AND NVL(PVI_EXP_DT,'12/31/9999')
WITH UR)
SELECT DISTINCT
PROV.PRV_ID AS PROV_ID,
CASE 
	WHEN PROVI.PVO_FIRST_NM IS NULL THEN INITCAP(PROVI.PVO_LAST_NM)
	ELSE (INITCAP(PROVI.PVO_FIRST_NM) || ' ' || INITCAP(PROVI.PVO_LAST_NM) )
END 				AS SUBMITTING_PROVIDER_NAME,
PSPEC.PVT_DESC		AS SUBMITTING_PROVIDER_TYPE,
NPI.PVI_ID			AS SUBMITTING_PROV_NPI,
STL.PVI_ID			AS SUBMITTING_PROV_STATE_LIC_NUM,
MCD.PVI_ID			AS SUBMITTING_PROV_MEDICAID_ID,
--FIN.PVI_ID          AS SUBMITTING_PROV_TAX_ID_SSN,
NAV.PVI_ID          AS "Submitting Provider Network Access Vendor"

FROM 		HS.PRV_PROVIDER 		AS PROV
JOIN 		HS.PVO_PROVIDER_ORG     AS PROVI ON PROV.PRV_ID = PROVI.PVO_PRV_ID AND PROV.PRV_PVT_CD = PROVI.PVO_TYPE AND PROVI.PVO_DEL_TS IS NULL 
		AND PROVI.PVO_ADD_TS = (SELECT PVO_ADD_TS FROM HS.PVO_PROVIDER_ORG JOIN HS.PRV_PROVIDER ON PVO_PRV_ID = PRV_ID AND PVO_TYPE = PRV_PVT_CD WHERE PVO_PRV_ID = PROVI.PVO_PRV_ID AND PVO_DEL_TS IS NULL ORDER BY PVO_ADD_TS DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY WITH UR)
LEFT JOIN HS.PVT_PROVIDER_TYPE	AS PSPEC ON PROVI.PVO_TYPE = PSPEC.PVT_CD
LEFT JOIN PROV_ID AS NPI ON PROV.PRV_ID = NPI.PVI_PRV_ID AND TRIM(NPI.PVI_TYPE) = 'XX' 
LEFT JOIN PROV_ID AS STL ON PROV.PRV_ID = STL.PVI_PRV_ID AND TRIM(STL.PVI_TYPE) = 'ST' 
LEFT JOIN PROV_ID AS MCD ON PROV.PRV_ID = MCD.PVI_PRV_ID AND MCD.PVI_TYPE = 'MCD'
--LEFT JOIN PROV_ID AS FIN ON PROV.PRV_ID = FIN.PVI_PRV_ID AND FIN.PVI_TYPE IN ('FIN','SSN')
LEFT JOIN PROV_ID AS NAV ON PROV.PRV_ID = NAV.PVI_PRV_ID AND NAV.PVI_TYPE = 'NAV'	

UNION ALL

SELECT DISTINCT
null 				AS PROV_ID,
null                AS  SUBMITTING_PROVIDER_NAME,
null        		AS SUBMITTING_PROVIDER_TYPE,
null    			AS SUBMITTING_PROV_NPI,
null    			AS SUBMITTING_PROV_STATE_LIC_NUM,
null    			AS SUBMITTING_PROV_MEDICAID_ID,
--null              	AS SUBMITTING_PROV_TAX_ID_SSN,
null                AS "Submitting Provider Network Access Vendor"

FROM BPAAS.MONTHLY_CAL

WITH UR
